text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh? An antique stall in a place like this?
Pretty stylish... hm?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha! What's this, it's suuuper cute!
A cat... wait no, a tanuki?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The craftsmanship is insanely detailed... Wait, are
these all one-of-a-kind? Unbelievable...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, you two.
Browsin' antiques, huh? Got good taste.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Inari-senpai!
Ah, yeah, caught our eye.
Not that we know anything about them though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ain't nothin' wrong with that.
Things like this are a once-in-a-lifetime encounter,
just pick the one that clicks with ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What you're holdin' is called a netsuke, basically
what people call charms or straps today.
Feels a lot more familiar when you think of it like that, don't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I get it~. So like,
what's the difference between this and that?
They're both cats, but the prices are crazy different.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's down to the materials used.
If you ain't too picky, the cheaper one's plenty good.
It's still a real fine piece of work.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay, that was seriously such a great purchase~!
Hey, Inari-san, you free after this?
Wanna hang out a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Let us repay you for your help just now.
This time, we'll pick out something that looks great on you, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hm? You two pickin' somethin' out for me, means—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I thought.
I'm so outta place here it's makin' me dizzy...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, now. It might not be your usual style,
Senpai, but we'll definitely find something that suits you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City's on fashion, and I'm on makeup!
We're gonna turn you into a super sparkly gyaru, so leave it to us~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: H-Haha... Go easy on me, will ya...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That top would look amazing on Inari-senpai for sure.
Now as for a skirt to match...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey! That leaves the belly completely exposed!
Feels like the Thunder God's gonna steal my belly button.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If you're matchin' it, that short skirt over there
would be nice. Finish it off by throwin' on a flashy hanten coat,
and you got a stylish blend of East and West!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Inari-san, how's this lip gloss? Look at that shine!
Let's get your lips all plump and glossy to blow everyone away!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's wild! It's so glossy it looks just like
high-grade sushi fresh from the chef's hands.
And putting that on the lips, huh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, while we're at it, let's doll up the eyes and nails too!
Knowin' how to rock the rouge is what being an Edokko's all about!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, ain't that jacket lookin' sharp?
What d'ya think, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Where did you learn about this style of fashion,
Inari-senpai? Your sense is legitimately good, I'm shocked...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Inari-san,
are you secretly a gyaru under all that?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gahah, you say the funniest things, Jordan...
Wait, maybe you ain't completely off the mark.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? For real?
I was just kidding, though...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No, I found it strange, too. How naturally I slipped
into the groove while checkin' out shops with you two.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Judgin' what's chic with your own eyes,
and dressin' up how you like followin' your own heart.
There ain't no difference between a gyaru and an Edokko there.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you and I share
the exact same spirit!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......Uh~, I get it???

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What she means is...
Inari-senpai thinks we're "chic."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? Aww~! What, that totally hypes me up~!

One day while out and about, I came across Inari One
and the others chatting merrily.
choice_data_list: You all look like you're having fun.
Looks like you guys are having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look like that to ya?
Well, we birds of a feather flock together, after all!
choice_data_list: Birds of a feather... as in everyone looks gyaru-ish?
For sure! Everyone has such a stylish "chic" vibe!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, nice one!
You sure got an eye for this stuff!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fufu, Inari-senpai really is so chic.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Omg, am I seriously "chic"?
That kinda makes me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're both dashing, stylish horse girls.
Guaranteed by yours truly!
